<!--
  PR TITLE = the squash commit on main, so use Conventional Commits:
    <type>(<scope>): <description>        e.g. feat(auth): add jwt authentication for /abc
  Types: feat · fix · perf · refactor · test · docs · build · ci · style · chore · revert
  Breaking change? Add "!" after the type/scope: refactor(api)!: rename /api/keys to /v1/keys

  Need a specialised template? Add a template parameter to the PR url:
    .../compare/main...my-branch?expand=1&template=feature.md
  Available: feature.md · bugfix.md · refactor.md · docs.md · release.md · security.md
-->

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` — dependencies, build or pipeline
- [ ] `style` / `chore` — formatting or maintenance
- [ ] ⚠️ **Breaking change** — requires action from users or other services
